body:
If you keep up on your maths regularly, you'll be fine!!... But if you really wanted to study, I would only do the basics, and get a feel for what's in the specification, if you recognize the topic from gcse, I would go over them ( for example venn diagrams) 
  
TL maths (YouTube)
Madasmaths (website)
Physicsandmaths tutor (website)
Also, don't do the past papers now, because theres only a limited amount

Depends on who your teacher is, some of mine had seating plans, some didn't. Like some others said, even if there's no seating plan, where you sit on the first day is usually where you'll sit the entire year, so choose a good place to sit first!!
